messages:
Liam: quick heads up rolled microbatch-heuristic alpha (mh-alpha) as a 8% canary at 01:15 UTC. bench highlights below.
Aisha: drop numbers pls
Liam: short table (canary vs baseline):
```
model | p50 | p95 | p99 | cost/unit
rwd-7b-chat | 58ms -> 42ms | 150ms -> 127ms | 310ms -> 270ms | 1.00 -> 0.89
rwd-13b-chat | 94ms -> 71ms | 380ms -> 330ms | 720ms -> 640ms | 1.00 -> 0.91
embedding-short | 34ms -> 26ms | 110ms -> 98ms | 240ms -> 210ms | 1.00 -> 0.92
```
Nora: nice improvements. what's the tradeoff?
Liam: worker-side CPU +4-7% depending on load; memory unchanged. benefit is fewer microbatches formed for short sequences so less queueing. observed queue depth drop ~18%.
Aisha: any error regressions?
Liam: deploy-bot health check summary: all checks green, two transient 504s during a region failover that predated the canary. ops-bot logged them as unrelated.
ops-bot: {"canary":"mh-alpha-2824","duration_min":50,"checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true},"notable":[]}

Nora: rollout plan?
Liam: 8% -> 25% in 3h -> 60% in 12h -> 100% in 48h if no alerts. auto-rollback if p99 > baseline + 30% for >5m or error rate >1% for >3m. manual fallback to mh-v0 in ops playbook.
Aisha: please add a 2-slide before/after + short rollback checklist for infra sync. also ping support to watch enterprise tenants.
Liam: will do, PR link after we merge the release: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/5021
Nora: GA ETA?
Liam: aiming GA in 7-10 days pending full rollout metrics and tenant smoke tests.
Aisha: exec one-liner when 100%: "Microbatch-heuristic alpha reduced short-request p50 by ~27% and p99 by ~13%, improving unit cost by ~9% in early canary."
Liam: ack. leaving canary watch on, ping here for urgent alerts.
deploy-bot: canary-monitoring: next automated summary in 12m.
